en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic building with a small tower and ornate cupola, likely a baroque or late‑renaissance structure. The house has multiple stories, shuttered windows, an arched loggia on the ground floor, and a steep tiled roof. Leafless trees and a garden or park area surround the building, with other houses visible in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the Minoriten-Schlössel near the Volksgarten in Graz.
